# The first disposal of a_usd_sale_spent_in_three_disposals_that_round_down.txt,
# the 0.72 USD bank charge of 2026-08-13, restated at 1.02 for
# `--strategy update`: 1.01 is its share of the cost rounded. Read as a new
# transaction would be (Q-051), what it drew is put back and drawn again, so
# on a book an earlier import left with its last disposal at its own share,
# 3,802.81, it takes the last 0.72 of the cost basis, and what is left of the
# cost is 1.02. The edit is accepted, and the book records the whole loss.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_the_last_disposal_of_a_cost_basis_takes_what_is_left_of_its_cost.py.
